intent_rationale: The patient expresses a reason to change alongside a perceived benefit of continuing to smoke, showing ambivalence, and proposes a specific initial action.
conversation_text:
Counselor: How are you feeling about cutting back on smoking this month?
Patient: I want to breathe more easily, but smoking is still how I handle stressful breaks at work. I could start by leaving my cigarettes at home on two workdays each week.
